question: Tell me about what you do at the bookshop, from opening until the end of your shift.
text: I usually get up around seven, make a cup of tea, and have some toast. Then I feed the cat before heading to the shop. I take the bus to work and meet my colleague to open the shop. We unlock the doors, turn on the lights, and start arranging the books. I spend most of my time helping customers, restocking shelves, and keeping the shop tidy. I like talking to people and recommending books. My shift ends around four, and I take the bus home. I try to keep a quiet routine because that seems to help me feel more stable.
